_comment: cL8-17 farm-band normal #1 (Z2-hardening pre-chunk, PO 2026-07-21): the spider line grown up — a heavyweight for the high-tier farm areas, poison identity via GiantVenomSpit (bite + venom; it carried the cL4 VenomSpider's VenomSpit until the 2026-07-22 damage fix — see that skill's comment). Own sprite/EntityType (PO ruling 2026-07-21: every mob gets unique art, higher tier looks meaner). Tanky for a normal: aura pressure + big pool = the band's attrition check. speed 0.6 -> 0.95 (PO 2026-07-22, from live play): mob velocity is 0.055 × speed against the player's flat 0.05/tick, so at 0.6 it moved at 66% of walking speed and could never hold anyone inside its 1.6 aura — its authored damage was unreachable by a player simply walking backwards, which is what made it 'a very easy win' regardless of the numbers. 0.95 matches AlphaWolf: it closes and stays on you. It is no longer a slow lurker. experience kph-derived per the Session-⑥ XP rule (3600×1.15^(cL−1) ÷ chain-battery kph) and is NOT re-derived for the new speed/damage — the kill is slower now, so the XP/h it actually pays has dropped; revisit if the farm band feels stingy. PO places spawns in the editor. All values [PLACEHOLDER]
name: GiantSpider
